description: Parts of the Bastion, an original heavy frame: shoulder saddles carry four shell arms that hang curved quarter-shells around the body.

parts.name: Bastion Arm Rotor
parts.description: The wrist of a folding leg: a slewing bearing and motor that turn the grapple.

parts.name: Bastion Arm Hinge
parts.description: A heavy hinge (shell-arm shoulder and wrist): clevis, knuckle on the pivot pin and a rotary vane actuator.

parts.name: Bastion Leg Hinge
parts.description: The first joint of a folding leg: swings the folded leg out from under its quarter.

parts.name: Bastion Shoulder Saddle (left)
parts.description: Bolted on a shoulder block: carries the shoulder hinges of a front and a back shell arm, their loads going down through the shoulder into the torso.

parts.name: Bastion Shoulder Saddle (right)
parts.description: Bolted on a shoulder block: carries the shoulder hinges of a front and a back shell arm, their loads going down through the shoulder into the torso.

parts.name: Bastion Torso
parts.description: The armoured torso and cockpit: crew hatch and viewport in the chest, side intakes, the reactor and its radiator on the back; the shoulders, neck and waist bolt to it.

parts.name: Bastion Head
parts.description: The sensor head: visor, main optics, side sensor pods and the antenna, on a turning neck bearing.

parts.name: Bastion Waist
parts.description: The pelvis: a slewing ring under the torso, the frame carrying both hip joints, and armour skirts front and back.

parts.name: Bastion Shoulder
parts.description: A shoulder block: turns the arm on the torso and carries a saddle for two shell arms on top.

parts.name: Bastion Limb
parts.description: An arm segment (upper arm or forearm): structural spine, armour shells and the rams that work the joint below.

parts.name: Bastion Leg
parts.description: A leg segment (thigh or shin): structural spine, armour with a knee guard and the twin rams that work the joint below.

parts.name: Bastion Foot
parts.description: A foot: treaded sole, split toe plates, heel spur and shock struts; carries the frame's weight.

parts.name: Bastion Hand
parts.description: A heavy three-fingered hand with an opposed thumb, its finger actuators inside the palm: the frame's own hands for work inside the cocoon.

parts.name: Bastion Shell Carrier (front) (left)
parts.description: The bracket a quarter is bolted to, on the shell arm's wrist: it carries the quarter and the folding leg's deploy hinge, and feeds both.

parts.name: Bastion Shell Carrier (front) (right)
parts.description: The bracket a quarter is bolted to, on the shell arm's wrist: it carries the quarter and the folding leg's deploy hinge, and feeds both.

parts.name: Bastion Leg Drop (front)
parts.description: The folding leg's first segment: from the carrier down inside the shell to the fold.

parts.name: Bastion Leg Bend (front) (left)
parts.description: A bent knee of a folding leg (turns the leg down into its fold).

parts.name: Bastion Leg Bend (front) (right)
parts.description: A bent knee of a folding leg (turns the leg down into its fold).

parts.name: Bastion Shell Carrier (back) (left)
parts.description: The bracket a quarter is bolted to, on the shell arm's wrist: it carries the quarter and the folding leg's deploy hinge, and feeds both.

parts.name: Bastion Shell Carrier (back) (right)
parts.description: The bracket a quarter is bolted to, on the shell arm's wrist: it carries the quarter and the folding leg's deploy hinge, and feeds both.

parts.name: Bastion Leg Drop (back)
parts.description: The folding leg's first segment: from the carrier down inside the shell to the fold.

parts.name: Bastion Leg Bend (back) (left)
parts.description: A bent knee of a folding leg (turns the leg down into its fold).

parts.name: Bastion Leg Bend (back) (right)
parts.description: A bent knee of a folding leg (turns the leg down into its fold).

parts.name: Bastion Fold Knee (left)
parts.description: A folding knee: its two segments lie side by side when folded and line up (with a small jog) when unfolded.

parts.name: Bastion Fold Knee (right)
parts.description: A folding knee: its two segments lie side by side when folded and line up (with a small jog) when unfolded.

parts.name: Bastion Leg Segment 1
parts.description: A folding-leg segment (7.3 m); the segments get thinner toward the grapple.

parts.name: Bastion Leg Segment 2
parts.description: A folding-leg segment (6.3 m); the segments get thinner toward the grapple.

parts.name: Bastion Leg Segment 3
parts.description: A folding-leg segment (6.3 m); the segments get thinner toward the grapple.

parts.name: Bastion Leg Segment 4
parts.description: A folding-leg segment (6.3 m); the segments get thinner toward the grapple.

parts.name: Bastion Leg Segment 5
parts.description: A folding-leg segment (6.3 m); the segments get thinner toward the grapple.

parts.name: Bastion Leg Segment 6
parts.description: A folding-leg segment (6.3 m); the segments get thinner toward the grapple.

parts.name: Bastion Grapple
parts.description: A three-claw grapple at the end of a folding leg.

parts.name: Bastion Shell Quarter (front left)
parts.description: The front-left curved quarter of the cocoon: large over the head and shoulders, tapering down to just above the ankles; fixed to its arm's carrier.

parts.name: Bastion Shell Quarter (front right)
parts.description: The front-right curved quarter of the cocoon: large over the head and shoulders, tapering down to just above the ankles; fixed to its arm's carrier.

parts.name: Bastion Shell Quarter (back left)
parts.description: The back-left curved quarter of the cocoon: large over the head and shoulders, tapering down to just above the ankles; fixed to its arm's carrier.

parts.name: Bastion Shell Quarter (back right)
parts.description: The back-right curved quarter of the cocoon: large over the head and shoulders, tapering down to just above the ankles; fixed to its arm's carrier.

parts.name: Bastion Lift Engine
parts.description: A compact engine mounted inside a shell quarter, exhaust toward the shell's inside: with the quarter tilted up into a platform, it blows down.

parts.name: Bastion Upper Arm (front)
parts.description: The first segment of a shell arm: from the shoulder up under the dome to the elbow.

parts.name: Bastion Arm Elbow (front left)
parts.description: A shell arm's elbow, folded into a V when closed; straightening it pushes the shell out.

parts.name: Bastion Arm Elbow (front right)
parts.description: A shell arm's elbow, folded into a V when closed; straightening it pushes the shell out.

parts.name: Bastion Forearm (front)
parts.description: The second segment of a shell arm: from the elbow back down to the wrist the shell turns on.

parts.name: Bastion Upper Arm (back)
parts.description: The first segment of a shell arm: from the shoulder up under the dome to the elbow.

parts.name: Bastion Arm Elbow (back left)
parts.description: A shell arm's elbow, folded into a V when closed; straightening it pushes the shell out.

parts.name: Bastion Arm Elbow (back right)
parts.description: A shell arm's elbow, folded into a V when closed; straightening it pushes the shell out.

parts.name: Bastion Forearm (back)
parts.description: The second segment of a shell arm: from the elbow back down to the wrist the shell turns on.
